settings.cast.label: Roles and their holders
settings.cast.body: Who fills each role here, and why. A person and an agent fill a role alike: a step names its role, and its holder comes from this place, never step by step. High risk and your marks keep a role yours whatever is chosen here. Each choice is kept with the reason beside it. Only you set this: an agent’s press of it goes on your card in every mode.
settings.cast.why.label: Why (kept with each choice)
settings.cast.why.owner: The owner role is always yours.
settings.cast.why.marked: Your mark keeps production releases yours.
settings.cast.why.risk: High risk: no agent fills a role here.
settings.cast.why.sign-in: Signing in is your act in a browser, so you fill it until a choice names another.
settings.cast.why.default: Nobody is chosen, so the role’s agent fills it until a choice names another.
settings.cast.unreadable: The saved choices do not read, so what is shown is the last good reading and no choice is kept until they do: {{problem}}
